description: Go modules fragment. Indirect dependencies are noise in a go.mod PR feed, so they are switched
off except when a vulnerability alert names one — that is exactly what
security:gomodIndirectSecurityUpdates encodes. gomodTidy keeps go.sum honest after every bump;
gomodMassage lets Renovate parse go.mod files that use replace directives.

packageRules.description: One PR per repo for every non-major Go module change.
The go directive and the toolchain line pick a language version — that is a platform decision, not a dependency bump. CI pins the same version, so drifting them apart silently breaks the build.
